observations: Photo 0: A framed photovoltaic panel with blue cells and white busbars standing upright on a floor.
Photo 1: A framed photovoltaic panel with dark cells leaning against a wall.
Both images carry a watermark reading "EMMY WORLD SOLAR LINK" and "POSTED ON JIJI".
No brand logo, model number, or wattage label is legible on either panel in the photos.

claims.evidence: No brand logo or nameplate visible in photo 0 or photo 1.
No specification label visible in photo 0 or photo 1.
Photo 0 and photo 1 show photovoltaic modules.

risks.risk: The panel's actual wattage is not 450W.
risks.proof: Photo of the rear nameplate showing rated power, voltage, and current.
risks.if_unproven: as a used panel of unknown output.

risks.risk: The panel does not generate power.
risks.proof: Video of a multimeter measuring open-circuit voltage and short-circuit current in sunlight.

risks.risk: The panel is not a Longi product.
risks.proof: Close-up photo of any branding on the frame or junction box.

proof_requests: Photo of the back label with model number and wattage.
Video of open-circuit voltage and short-circuit current measured outdoors in daylight.
Close-up of the frame and junction box for a brand logo.
response.reason: The photos show a solar panel, so it can be priced at its worst case as an unverified used unit; the seller's brand and wattage claims cannot be confirmed from the images.
